description: Use this tool when a search needs extra filters: learning language, a verified age range, the published flag, or paging. It lexically searches published North Dakota Fairytales school lessons, books, songs, videos, games, coloring pages, stories, and encyclopedia articles. It does not translate the query and does not rank the brand in outside search engines. For a simple query, find_ndf_content is the shorter call.

age.description: Match only resources with a verified age range that includes this age.

category.description: Published product category: organization, school, encyclopedia, books, songs, video, games, coloring-pages, or stories.

learningLanguage.description: Language being taught, when the resource records one. This is not the interface locale.

locale.description: Interface locale code from the 77-locale registry, such as en, ru, ar, or zh-Hans.

published.description: false returns no rows because the catalog stores published resources only.

query.description: Lexical query, maximum 200 characters. Omit it to list by filters.

name: search_resources
title: Search published resources
